# KitCrew

> KitCrew is the AI workforce for network marketers and affiliates: six AI agents (Follow-Up, Content, Lead, Engagement, Duplication, Triage) that run the daily work of the business — trained on what the member actually sells, approve-first by default. A product of KitFire AI Inc ("KitCrew, by KitFire"). No income claims, ever.

## What KitCrew is
- **Category:** an AI workforce for the network marketing / affiliate marketing niche — follow-up, content, lead response, social engagement, teammate onboarding, and inbox triage, run by six named agents.
- **Positioning:** the tool pile — a separate app for every job — is what actually kills duplication, not the product. KitCrew replaces the pile with one system trained on what the member sells.
- **Hard rule:** income claims are blocked at the system level in every agent's output. KitCrew is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or a distributor of any network marketing company.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://kitcrew.ai/): what KitCrew is, the six agents, how onboarding works, pricing.
- [FAQ](https://kitcrew.ai/faq/): direct answers — income claims, working with your company, MarketHive membership, the referral dashboard.
- [MarketHive members](https://kitcrew.ai/markethive/): the Entrepreneur One / Super Groups free build-out for MarketHive members.
- [Blog](https://kitcrew.ai/blog/): plain-English posts on follow-up, content, leads, and engagement for network marketers and affiliates.
- [Video Prompts](https://kitcrew.ai/prompts/): free AI video prompt playbook — four complete video prompts, the eleven-block prompt structure for cinematic AI video, and the rules that stop generated footage looking fake.

## Pricing
- **Duplicator Pro** — $299/month or $2,990/year (two months free), 1 seat, all six agents included. One plan, no tiers.
